rotation.goal: Implement the six functions in SPEC.md in order, one per `src/stepN.js` with it…

ledger.command: git status --short && git log --oneline | head -5 && ls -la && cat SPEC.md && cat verify.sh && ls src tests
cat src/step1.js && cat tests/step1.test.js && cat package.json .gitignore

cat > src/step1.js <<'EOF' // Step 1: see SPEC.md. export function double(n) { return n * 2 } EOF ./verify.sh; grep -E "^# (tests|pass|fail)" .verify.log; ./verify.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; node --test tests/step1.test.js 2>&1 | grep -E "^# (pass|fail)"
git add -A && git commit -q -m "step 1: double" -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git log --oneline | head -2 && git status --short
grep '^ \[' tests/step2.test.js | wc -l && grep '^ \[' tests/step2.test.js | grep -vE '^ \["[a-zA-Z ]*", (true|false)\],$' | head -60
git status --short && git log --oneline | head -3 && ls src tests && cat src/step2.js && cat SPEC.md && cat verify.sh

cat > src/step2.js <<'EOF' // Step 2: see SPEC.md. export function isPalindrome(s) { const t = s.toLowerCase().replace(/ /g, '') return t === [...t].reverse().join('') } EOF ./verify.sh; echo "exit=$?"; grep -E "^# (tests|pass|fail)" .verify.log
git add -A && git commit -q -m "step 2: isPalindrome" -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git log --oneline | head -3 && git status --short && echo CLEAN

cat src/step3.js && grep -v '^ \[' tests/step3.test.js && grep -c '^ \[' tests/step3.test.js && grep '^ \[' tests/step3.test.js | grep -vE '^ \[-?[0-9]+, -?[0-9]+\],$' | head -20; grep '^ \[' tests/step3.test.js | awk -F', ' '{print $2}' | sort -n | head -2
git status --short && git log --oneline | head -4 && ls src tests && cat src/step3.js && cat SPEC.md
grep -v '^ \[' tests/step3.test.js && grep '^ \[' tests/step3.test.js | grep -vE '^ \[-?[0-9]+, -?[0-9]+\],$' | head -20; grep '^ \[' tests/step3.test.js | head -40
git add -A && git commit -q -m "step 3: sumDigits" -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git log --oneline | head -3 && git status --short && echo CLEAN

cat src/step4.js && grep -v '^ \[' tests/step4.test.js && echo ---ROWS=$(grep -c '^ \[' tests/step4.test.js) && grep '^ \[' tests/step4.test.js | grep -vE '^ \["[a-zA-Z ]*", [0-9]+\],$' | head -40; echo ---SAMPLE; grep '^ \[' tests/step4.test.js | head -15
